summary: Preview smoke test and authenticated Kanban flow completed. Login, seeded board, search/filter/reset, task creation, and backend task update work; frontend edit modal does not close and column management controls are missing.

ui_bugs.issue: After editing and saving a task, the PATCH succeeds and data persists, but the modal remains open. The user cannot see the updated board until manually closing it.
Clicking a column menu sets modal type to column, but no modal is rendered; rename and delete controls are unavailable. This blocks the requested column rename and move-to-To-Do/delete policy flow.

action_items: Close TaskModal and refresh board state after successful edit.
Implement the column menu modal with rename and delete actions, including the selected move-to-To-Do/delete-tasks policy.
Run the remaining member invitation, drag/drop persistence, registration, and responsive regression flows after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: Board.js renders modal?.type === task/comments/add-column/member but never renders modal?.type === column, making the column menu a dead-end interaction.
seed_data_creation: Created a temporary Regression task and Review column through the demo board during testing; these remain in the preview database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL loads. Demo credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md work. Existing test data includes Regression task edited and Review column on board 1. Backend is stopped in the local supervisor but public preview API responds normally.
rca of the issue: Task edit path awaits the PATCH but only addTask closes the modal; the edit branch omits setModal(null). Column menu assigns {type:'column'}, but Board has no conditional renderer for that type, so the click produces no usable controls.
